data.one_liner: A clean, minimalistic and collaboration-ready rich text editor for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Fleather provides a rich text editor and toolbar for Flutter applications based on Parchment document models. It supports inline formatting, lists, block attributes, embeds, and markdown semantics.
use_when: You need a WYSIWYG or rich text editor in your Flutter app.
You want a Quill.js Delta-compatible data model for your documents.
avoid_when: You only need a basic single-line TextField or standard unformatted input.
You require fully built-in operational transformation (OT) collaboration out of the box.
strengths: Supports inline, line, and block attributes like bold, lists, quotes, and code blocks.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Linux, and Windows.
Uses Quill.js Delta format via Parchment, making it ready for collaborative editing.
weaknesses: Collaboration via OT is not provided as a built-in functionality.
Limited to the styling paradigms and document models provided by Parchment.
data.setup_notes: Add fleather to pubspec.yaml and instantiate a FleatherController with a ParchmentDocument.
